news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 7.8% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Minor Risks Share price has been volatile over the past 3 months (7.8% average weekly change). Large one-off items impacting financial results.

news.title: Inox Green Energy Services Limited (NSEI:INOXGREEN) and Inox Neo Energies entered into letter of intent to acquire IPP and O&M portfolios from Wind World (India) Limited in a deal expected to be worth INR 28 billion, according to Business Line sources.
news.body: Inox Green Energy Services Limited (NSEI:INOXGREEN) and Inox Neo Energies entered into letter of intent to acquire IPP and O&M portfolios from Wind World (India) Limited in a deal expected to be worth INR 28 billion, according to Business Line sources on February 19, 2026. As per the transaction, Inox Neo Energies will acquire Wind World India’s  IPP portfolio and Inox Green Energy Services Limited will acquire O&M businesses of Wind World India. IPP portfolio consist of 600 MW, with wind farms spread across seven key wind-rich states: Karnataka, Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Rajasthan, Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh and Andhra Pradesh. And, O&M portfolio stands at nearly 4.5 GW, servicing a marquee client base that includes leading corporates such as the Tata Group, ReNew, Greenko Group, Apraava Ener

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.65 (vs ₹0.15 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.65 (up from ₹0.15 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹1.12b (up 83% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹246.9m (up 421% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 22% (up from 7.8% in 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 97% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 58% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.
